mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS subscription_id, s.activity_id, a.title, a.summary, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, a.activity_type, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status AS activity_status, sa.name AS street_area_name, s.status AS subscription_status, s.created_at AS subscribed_at FROM activity_subscription s JOIN activity a ON s.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN street_area sa ON a.street_area_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON a.cover_file_id = sf.id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_subscription s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
